high_level_description: stc brand style, a night-shift industrial worker checking a tablet beneath a formation of satellites in the starry sky.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark industrial site at night with warm lights glowing from machinery and a starry sky filled with a row of satellites overhead.

elements.desc: A man wearing a white hard hat and a high-visibility safety jacket, looking down at a tablet in his hands.
A row of satellites with solar panels flying in formation across the night sky.
A dashed line diagram connecting a speed gauge icon and a battery/lightning icon to the scene below, suggesting network monitoring.
